task.title: Create an OpenShift Container Platform integration
task.shortdesc: You can connect your Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform environment to the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console as an integration so that you can use OpenShift Container Platform data with cost management.

ul.li: You are logged in to the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console as an Organization Administrator or as a user with Cloud Administrator permissions. You cannot log in to the Hybrid Cloud Console with your email address unless your email address is the same as your Red Hat login. For more information, see .
You have access to an OpenShift Container Platform environment that you want to use with the Hybrid Cloud Console.

step.cmd: Click Add integration to open the integrations wizard. If this is the first integration you are adding, skip this step.
Select Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform, and then click Next.
Enter a descriptive name for the integration, for example, my_ocp_integration, and then click Next.
Select Cost Management as the application, and then click Next.
To install and configure the costmanagement-metrics-operator, use the steps in the wizard, and then click Next. Refer to for additional information.
Enter the Cluster Identifier, and then click Next.
Review the integration details, and then click Add to finish adding the integration.

ol.li: Go to the Integrations page, and select the Red Hat tab.
Confirm that your OpenShift Container Platform integration is listed and the status is Ready.
